list.name: node_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT node_id FROM tessellation_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY node_id

list.name: network_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT network_id FROM tessellation_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY network_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 15 SECOND) AS time, substring(node_id, 1, 8) AS node, max(value) AS value FROM tessellation_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'dag_global_snapshot_ordinal' AND timestamp BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND ($__conditionalAll(node_id IN ($node_id), $node_id)) GROUP BY time, node ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 15 SECOND) AS time, max(value) - min(value) AS value FROM tessellation_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'dag_global_snapshot_ordinal' AND timestamp BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND ($__conditionalAll(node_id IN ($node_id), $node_id)) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

WITH diffs AS (SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS time, node_id, max(value) - lagInFrame(max(value)) OVER (PARTITION BY node_id ORDER BY toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE)) AS delta FROM tessellation_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'dag_global_snapshot_blocks_total' AND timestamp BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND ($__conditionalAll(node_id IN ($node_id), $node_id)) GROUP BY time, node_id) SELECT time, 'max' AS node, max(delta) AS value FROM diffs WHERE delta >= 0 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
